WITH country_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_mean
  FROM country_avg
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
  FROM country_avg ca, overall_avg oa
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > oa.overall_mean
),
above_avg_group_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as above_avg_mean
  FROM above_overall
),
final_countries AS (
  SELECT aa.country, aa.avg_wins
  FROM above_overall aa, above_avg_group_avg aag
  WHERE aa.avg_wins > aag.above_avg_mean
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_wins) as mean_wins,
  AVG(avg_wins - (SELECT overall_mean FROM overall_avg)) as mean_excess_overall,
  AVG(avg_wins - (SELECT above_avg_mean FROM above_avg_group_avg)) as mean_excess_above_avg
FROM final_countries;
